name: PossessedWatchdog
identity: Dark olive bulky guard dog with amber eyes, large cream tusklike fangs, heavy ochre spiked collar attached around neck as part of the HEAD group, ragged gold dorsal spines and scars, one SHORT pointed rounded nub tail, four broad paws. The tail is the small oval point visible in the source atlas, NOT bushy or long.
reference_review: Actually viewed full source prefab and original atlas. Collar stays with head. Forepaws olive, hind toes ochre; short nub tail.
